title: See utilization and availability

question: Where are we under target today, and which parts of the workforce are sitting available?

answer.question: Where are we under target today, and which parts of the workforce are sitting available?
answer.answer:
Here's the snapshot:

**Gap to target:** Firm utilization is 43.8% vs. 85% target — a 41.2pp shortfall. By level: Mid (21.2%) and Junior (0%) are worst, Senior (64.5%) also below target. Manager level is actually on track at 95%.

**Who's sitting idle (5 on bench, $74K/month):**
- Chen Wei — Senior, AI/ML, Python ($295/hr)
- Robert Garcia — Mid, ERP/D365 ($195/hr)
- Sarah Kim — Mid, Cloud Architecture/AWS ($185/hr)
- David Okafor — Mid, Data Analytics/Power BI ($175/hr)
- James Wright — Junior, Business Analysis ($125/hr)

Notably Sarah Kim has Cloud Architecture/AWS skills — potentially valuable if pipeline needs them. Want me to run a pipeline match to see if any of these can be staffed now?
